text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The private sector accounted for 68.2 percent of industrial output and 83.2 percent of construction in 1996.
- The Slovak parliament on Wednesday approved the creation of a committee to supervise the secret service, but failed to approve its members.
- Commercial bank Istrobanka expects to post a net profit of around 100 millin crowns for 1996. The bank's balance sum totalled 21 billion crowns last year.
- The National Bank of Slovakia has still not approved the sale of the Slovak branch of Czech bank Agrobanka to a consortium of unnamed Slovak companies.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Slovak parliament is expected to vote on a law on the creation of a state exim bank on Thursday.
- There are currently between 20 and 25 registered investment funds in Slovakia.
- State subsidies for employment totalled 7.35 billion crowns in 1996. Some 4.29 billion went to the creation of new jobs.
- Slovakia's largest insurer Slovenska Poistovna has called an extraordinary shareholders' meeting for February 18. The agenda of the meeting includes changes to the company's statutes.
PRAVDA - The average wage in industry rose 8.4 percent year-on-year in 1996, while the increase in the construction sector was 10.1 percent.
